typename gsQuadRule<T>::uPtr QuRule = gsQuadrature::getPtr(...);

```

The new `setupCoefficientScaling` gives the standard coefficient (ρ-) scaling. I found no defect introduced by this change.

- **What it computes:** `tmp[r]` adds up `coef` over the subdomains that Lagrange multiplier `r` touches. Each multiplier joins two subdomains, so for subdomain `k`, `tmp[r] - coef[k]` is the coefficient of the other subdomain. - **Storage:** `m_localScaling` already has one entry per subdomain, filled in by `push_back` in the header (line 111), so `m_localScaling[k]` is valid. Each `sc` is resized before it is written.
